name: Intercessors
overview: Scripture reveals that intercession is a vital ministry rooted in Christ's ongoing work on our behalf, as He is described as making intercession for us at the right hand of God (Romans 8:34). Jesus promised to send another Comforter to abide with believers forever, emphasizing the continuing presence and support believers receive through prayer (John 14:16). Just as Christ was sent into the world, He sends His followers, who are called to live and serve in obedience to His mission (John 17:18). The disciples' uncertainty about Jesus' path highlights the need for divine guidance and intercession to know the way (John 14:5).
